decision: the block-handover fusion is part of the delivery path
what_it_is: cosine cross-fade over the 5-frame overlap between adjacent 22-frame blocks, applied to frames run_deploy already writes to block{k:03d}/ and previously discarded

why.reading: the jump was ours, not a cost of streaming: a published streaming baseline is smoother at its handovers than inside its blocks

not_a_contribution: this is the standard overlap-blend. The variant that would have been ours -- fuse only the generated component, take the observed component from one block, which the range/null decomposition permits and which Morphe's finding that naive blending blurs suggests should matter -- measured identically (LPIPS +0.0000, handover jump +0.0003). The hypothesis is retired.
cost: post-processing only, no resampling; about 30 CPU-minutes for 77 clips
